# gtk4 is placed in SNGL: the program is calls of the platform's protocol
# functions, which GTK's C and the runtime's (lib/platform/gtk4/rt) answer, C
# calling them as it calls C and Go through the wrappers cgogen writes, so a
# Go program has no cgo of its own.
# A click is the GLib signal a test emits, which reaches the closure through
# g_signal_connect_data's callback, and a test's component is shown in a toplevel of
# its own.

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=c app.sngl
stdout 'ok +2 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok +2 tests, 0 failures'

# Both languages draw alike: C records the snapshots, and Go is held to
# them.

env SNGL_UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=1
sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=c snap.sngl
stdout 'ok +2 tests, 0 failures'
env SNGL_UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=
sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go snap.sngl
stdout 'ok +2 tests, 0 failures'

# A button given a background shades it itself as it is hovered and pressed,
# as the theme would, which a test sees by putting it in either state
# (gtk4.hover, gtk4.press) and drawing it: C records the snapshots, and Go is
# held to them.
env SNGL_UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=1
sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=c hover.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'
env SNGL_UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=
sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go hover.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'

# Every leaf widget and layout gtk4 overrides, in both languages: a test
# flips a check button or a switch, types into an entry, picks a choice and a
# day, presses a card, each through the signal GTK would emit, the value it
# reads off the widget put there first. The form's
# `row` is the name the table's override loops over its rows by, which a test
# build holds in the scope the loop shadows.

env SNGL_UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=1
sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=c widgets.sngl
stdout 'ok +9 tests, 0 failures'
env SNGL_UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=
sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go widgets.sngl
stdout 'ok +9 tests, 0 failures'
# Called directly (`cgo=direct`), Go compiles the runtime beside the program
# and draws the same.
sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go --opt cgo=direct widgets.sngl
stdout 'ok +9 tests, 0 failures'

# A root component's windows are the application's, not children of the box
# it renders them into: a window under an `if` comes and goes with it, its
# effect and its timer with it, and a snapshot is the first window.

env SNGL_UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=1
sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go windows.sngl
stdout 'ok +2 tests, 0 failures'
env SNGL_UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=
sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=c windows.sngl
stdout 'ok +2 tests, 0 failures'

# A window's `@key` hears a key a test presses through the runtime's
# toplevel. C hands a callback no function to call, so the handler takes
# nothing and reads the key off the runtime while it runs, and the stop it
# hands the program's handler is the runtime's, which calls the test's.
sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=c keys.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go keys.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'

# A window's menu and its way back are the runtime's: each entry a hidden box
# among the window's content, from which it builds the header bar's menu, and
# the way back a hidden widget the bar's back button presses. A test goes back
# through the runtime, as the button does, and the bar is drawn. An entry a
# test picks is the program's own record.
env SNGL_UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=1
sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go menus.sngl
stdout 'ok +2 tests, 0 failures'
env SNGL_UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=
sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=c menus.sngl
stdout 'ok +2 tests, 0 failures'

# A scroll's end arriving is no GTK signal: the runtime reads it off the
# adjustments, and a test fires the handler it keeps.
env SNGL_UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=1
sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=c scroll.sngl
stdout 'ok +2 tests, 0 failures'
env SNGL_UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=
sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go scroll.sngl
stdout 'ok +2 tests, 0 failures'

# A canvas is painted through its protocol: its shapes are the handler of
# its paint, handed cairo's context, and a write to what they read redraws
# it, the board's clicks and each dot's own.
env SNGL_UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=1
sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=c canvas.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'
env SNGL_UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=
sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go canvas.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'

# Pictures: a canvas paints a carried file and a drawing into boxes of its
# own, an image's drawing paints again when what it reads changes, an image
# whose file is missing says why, and the window's favicon is its icon
# rather than a picture in it.
exec sh -c 'echo iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAABAAAAAQCAIAAACQkWg2AAAAGElEQVR4nGL5z0AaYIIxRjWMahh+GgADAEleASJ7ejoXAAAAAElFTkSuQmCC | base64 -d > logo.png'
env SNGL_UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=1
sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=c pictures.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'
env SNGL_UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=
sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go pictures.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'

-- app.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import test "sngl:test"

component main ui.node {
    var n = 0
    ui.vbox {
        ui.text #label(value="clicked {n}", @click {
            n += 10
        })
        ui.button #count(text="{n}", @click {
            n += 1
        })
    }
}

ui.window(title="t") {
    main()
}

func testClickReachesTheClosure(t test.Test, c main) {
    c.count.click()
    c.count.click()
    t.assert(c.n == 2)
}

// A label has no signal for a press: the runtime's click gesture is it.
func testTextClicks(t test.Test, c main) {
    c.label.click()
    t.assert(c.n == 10)
}

-- widgets.sngl --
import test "sngl:test"
import time "sngl:time"
import ui "sngl:ui"

component form ui.node {
    var on = false
    var flip = false
    var name = "a"
    var size = "S"
    var pick = 1
    var links = 0
    var cards = 0
    var row = -1
    var closed = 0
    var leaf = ""
    ui.vbox {
        ui.checkbox #cb(label="On", :checked=on)
        ui.toggle #tg(:checked=flip)
        ui.input #in(:value=name)
        ui.textarea(value="multi")
        ui.select #sel(:value=size) {
            ui.choice(label="S", value="S")
            ui.choice(label="M", value="M")
        }
        ui.radio #rad(:value=pick) {
            ui.choice(label="One", value=1)
            ui.choice(label="Two", value=2)
        }
        ui.link #ln(text="go", href="https://example.com", @click { links += 1 })
        ui.card #cd(clickable=true, @click { cards += 1 }) {
            ui.text(value="card")
        }
        ui.hbox {
            ui.progress(value=3.0, max=10.0)
            ui.spinner(label="busy")
            ui.divider()
            ui.spacer()
        }
        ui.grid(columns=2) {
            ui.text(value="1")
            ui.text(value="2")
            ui.text(value="3")
        }
        ui.tooltip(text="tip") {
            ui.text(value="hover")
        }
        ui.table(columns=["a", "b"], selectable=true, :selected=row) {
            ui.tableRow(cells=["1", "2"])
            ui.tableRow(cells=["3", "4"])
        }
        ui.toolbar {
            ui.button(text="t")
        }
        ui.splitview {
            ui.text(value="L")
            ui.text(value="R")
        }
        ui.tree(:selected=leaf) {
            ui.treeItem(label="root") {
                ui.treeItem(label="leaf")
            }
        }
        ui.modal(open=true, title="M", closable=true, @close { closed += 1 }) {
            component content {
                ui.text(value="in modal")
            }
        }
    }
}

component calendar ui.node {
    var day option[time.date] = null
    ui.datepicker #dp(:value=day)
}

ui.window(title="w") {
    form()
}

func testCheckbox(t test.Test, c form) {
    c.cb.change(true)
    t.assert(c.on)
}

func testToggle(t test.Test, c form) {
    c.tg.change(true)
    t.assert(c.flip)
}

func testInput(t test.Test, c form) {
    c.in.input("bob")
    t.assert(c.name == "bob")
}

func testSelect(t test.Test, c form) {
    c.sel.change("M")
    t.assert(c.size == "M")
}

func testRadio(t test.Test, c form) {
    c.rad.change(2)
    t.assert(c.pick == 2)
}

func testInputActivates(t test.Test, c form) {
    c.in.change("zed")
    t.assert(c.name == "zed")
}

func testCard(t test.Test, c form) {
    c.cd.click()
    t.assert(c.cards == 1)
}

func testDrawsTheWidgets(t test.Test, c form) {
    t.snapshot("widgets")
}

func testDatepicker(t test.Test, c calendar) {
    c.dp.change(time.parseDate("2026-03-04"))
    t.assert(c.day == time.parseDate("2026-03-04"))
    t.snapshot("calendar")
}
-- windows.sngl --
import test "sngl:test"
import time "sngl:time"
import ui "sngl:ui"

// Two windows and a third under an `if`, from one root component, which share
// its state; the timer ticks only while the details window is up.
component app root {
    var details = false
    var mounts = 0
    var ticks = 0

    ui.window #main(title="Main") {
        ui.text(value="mounted {mounts}")
        ui.button #toggle(text="Details", @click {
            details = !details
        })
        ui.button #show(text="Log", @click {
            log.open()
        })
    }

    ui.window #log(title="Log", visible=false) {
        ui.text(value="the log")
        ui.button(text="Clear")
    }

    if details {
        ui.window(title="Details") {
            ui.text(value="details")
            effect(@mount {
                mounts += 1
            })
            time.timer(interval=10ms, @tick {
                ticks += 1
            })
        }
    }
}

func testDrawsTheFirstWindowAlone(t test.Test, c app) {
    t.snapshot("main")
    c.toggle.click()
    t.assert(c.mounts == 1)
    c.show.click()
    t.assert(c.log.visible)
}

func testATimerTicksWhileItsWindowIsUp(t test.Test, c app) {
    c.toggle.click()
    t.wait(func() => c.ticks >= 2, 2000)
    c.toggle.click()
    t.assert(c.mounts == 1)
}
-- keys.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import test "sngl:test"

component app root {
    var typed = ""
    var count = 0
    ui.window #win(title="t", @key(e, stop) {
        if e.ctrl {
            return
        }
        typed = typed + e.key
        count += int.parse(e.key).or(0)
        if e.key == "x" {
            stop()
        }
        if e.shift && e.editing {
            typed = typed + "!"
        }
    }) {
        ui.text(value=typed)
    }
}

app()

func testKeysReachTheWindow(t test.Test, c app) {
    var stopped = 0
    c.win.key(ui.KeyPress{key="7"}, func() { stopped += 1 })
    c.win.key(ui.KeyPress{key="x"}, func() { stopped += 1 })
    c.win.key(ui.KeyPress{key="s", ctrl=true}, func() { stopped += 1 })
    c.win.key(ui.KeyPress{key="Q", shift=true, editing=true}, func() { stopped += 1 })
    t.assert(c.typed == "7xQ!")
    t.assert(stopped == 1)
    t.assert(c.count == 7)
}
-- menus.sngl --
import nav "sngl:ui/nav"
import ui "sngl:ui"
import test "sngl:test"

const sizes = ["Small", "Medium", "Large"]

component app root {
    var size = "Medium"
    var saved = 0
    var backs = 0

    ui.window #main(title=pages.current.title, canGoBack=pages.canGoBack(), @back {
        backs += 1
        pages.back()
    }) {
        component menu {
            ui.menuItem(label="File") {
                ui.menuItem(label="Save", @select { saved += 1 })
                ui.menuItem(label="Close", disabled=true)
            }
            ui.menuItem(label="Size") {
                for var s = sizes {
                    ui.menuItem(label=s, checked=s == size, @select { size = s })
                }
            }
        }
        nav.stack #pages {
            nav.page #home(href="/", title="Home") {
                ui.text(value="home")
            }
            nav.page #about(href="/about", title="About") {
                ui.text(value="about")
            }
        }
        ui.button #toAbout(text="About", @click { pages.go(about) })
        ui.text #shown(value=size)
    }
}

app()

func testPickingAnEntryChecksIt(t test.Test, c app) {
    t.assert(c.main.menu[1].children[1].checked)
    c.main.menu[1].children[2].select()
    t.assert(c.shown.value == "Large")
    c.main.menu[0].children[0].select()
    t.assert(c.saved == 1)
}

func testTheWindowsBackReturns(t test.Test, c app) {
    t.assert(!c.main.canGoBack)
    c.toAbout.click()
    t.assert(c.main.canGoBack)
    t.snapshot("back")
    c.main.back()
    t.assert(c.backs == 1)
    t.assert(c.main.title == "Home")
}
-- scroll.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import test "sngl:test"

component main ui.node {
    var rows = [1, 2, 3]
    var asked = 0
    var way = ui.ScrollDirection.vertical
    ui.vbox {
        ui.text #label(value="{way}")
        ui.scroll #list(direction=way, style={height=60px, padding=12px, background=#ccccff}, @reachEnd {
            asked += 1
            rows.push(asked + 3)
        }) {
            ui.vbox {
                for var r = rows {
                    ui.text(value="row {r}")
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

ui.window(title="t") {
    main()
}

func testTheEndAsksForMore(t test.Test, c main) {
    c.list.reachEnd()
    t.assert(c.asked == 1)
    t.snapshot("more")
}

func testADirectionIsItsName(t test.Test, c main) {
    t.assert(string(c.way) == "vertical")
    c.way = ui.ScrollDirection.both
    t.assert(string(c.way) == "both")
    t.assert("{c.way}" == "both")
}
-- canvas.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import test "sngl:test"
import draw "sngl:ui/draw"

component dot(r float) ui.node {
    var n = 0
    ui.vbox {
        draw.canvas(width=40px, height=40px) {
            draw.circle(cx=20.0, cy=20.0, r=r + float(n), style={fill=#3366CC})
        }
        ui.button #grow(text="grow", @click {
            n += 1
        })
    }
}

component main ui.node {
    var hits = 0
    var rs = [4.0, 8.0]
    ui.vbox {
        draw.canvas #board(width=40px, height=40px, scalingMode=draw.ScalingMode.fit, @click {
            hits += 1
        }) {
            draw.rect(x=0.0, y=0.0, w=float(hits) * 10.0, h=10.0, style=draw.Style{fill=#CC3333, lineCap=draw.LineCap.round})
        }
        for var r = rs {
            dot(r=r)
        }
    }
}

ui.window(title="t") {
    main()
}

func testClickRedraws(t test.Test, c main) {
    t.snapshot("before")
    c.board.click()
    c.board.click()
    t.assert(c.hits == 2)
    t.snapshot("after")
}
-- pictures.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import draw "sngl:ui/draw"
import test "sngl:test"
import here "file:."

// A canvas paints a carried file and a drawing into boxes of its own, an
// image's drawing paints again when what it reads changes, an image whose
// file is missing says why, and the window's favicon is its icon, not a
// picture in it. Each is big enough that a snapshot sees it go wrong.
component board root {
    var failed = ""
    var shade = #0000AA

    ui.window(title="t") {
        component favicon {
            draw.image(width=200.0, height=200.0) {
                draw.rect(x=0.0, y=0.0, w=200.0, h=200.0, style={fill=#FF00FF})
            }
        }
        draw.canvas(width=400px, height=200px) {
            draw.canvasImage(x=0.0, y=0.0, w=200.0, h=200.0) {
                ui.file(path=here.path("logo.png"))
            }
            draw.canvasImage(x=200.0, y=0.0, w=200.0, h=200.0) {
                draw.image(width=20.0, height=20.0) {
                    draw.rect(x=0.0, y=0.0, w=10.0, h=10.0, style={fill=#00AA00})
                }
            }
        }
        ui.image {
            draw.image(width=300.0, height=100.0) {
                draw.rect(x=0.0, y=0.0, w=300.0, h=100.0, style={fill=shade})
            }
        }
        ui.button #paint(text="paint", @click {
            shade = #AA0000
        })
        ui.image(@error(e) { failed = e.message }) {
            ui.file(path="missing.png")
        }
    }
}

func testBoard(t test.Test, c board) {
    t.wait(func() => c.failed != "", 2000)
    t.assert(c.failed != "")
    t.snapshot("board")
    c.paint.click()
    t.snapshot("painted")
}
